failure_diagnosis.cause: Harness compared strict DIMACS declared variable counts to different GBD catalog metadata. Three workers exited before either packer; original input identities and parser semantics did not change.

experiment-sha256.json.serialization: UTF-8 encoding of json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) plus one LF; exact original 2,854-row manifest, not a replacement manifest.

reconstruction: The embedded losslessly encoded Python 3 decoder reconstructs all 14 payloads with exact byte counts and SHA-256 checks. Thirteen payloads are independently Python base85/XZ encoded. The 2,854-row manifest derives 979 paths and SHA-256 values per source prefix from public Git commit cb14031d4187c4cba5cccb37984ecf59d59bfdae, applies the one recorded candidate override, and retains all 896 other rows in an encoded mapping. It serializes the exact original manifest. This publishes the complete report, execution accounting and manifest, not every raw runtime file. A local copy of the pinned public Git object is required; the decoder makes no network calls. This remains separate from a permanent public raw reproduction release.

reconstruction_decoder.extract_command: python -c 'import base64,hashlib,json,lzma,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["reconstruction_decoder"]; b=lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(d["base64"],validate=True)); ok=len(b)==d["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==d["sha256"]; ok or sys.exit("decoder identity mismatch"); open(d["filename"],"xb").write(b)' packing_study_v1_result_20261021.json
preparation: Obtain the exact public source object if absent: git -C /path/to/SPECTRA fetch --no-tags https://github.com/tugrapaydiner/SPECTRA.git cb14031d4187c4cba5cccb37984ecf59d59bfdae
Run extract_command in an empty working directory to verify and exclusively write the complete decoder, then inspect the decoded source before running.
Run the usage command with a fresh output directory whose parent exists. All payload hashes are checked before any output is written; existing destinations are refused.

scope: Local exposed Python packing experiment only. No general speedup, field ranking, hidden-set, external replication, release or 100/100 claim.
